title: Claypot Chicken German Style
description: A twist on traditional German cuisine, using Malaysian claypot cooking. Tender and flavorful, this dish is sure to be a hit.
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and flour. Heat a large oven-safe claypot over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the claypot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove chicken from the claypot and set aside.
Add more oil to the claypot if needed, then sauté onions and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add beer, chicken broth, and claypot seasoning to the claypot. Stir to combine.
Return chicken to the claypot, cover with a lid, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
